Title: Barrier Cleansing Oil
Description:
For removing sunscreen without stripping

A silky first cleanse that dissolves sunscreen, sweat and city grime while leaving your skin's natural lipids where they belong. Emulsifies into a soft milk and rinses clean, so there is no oily film and no tight feeling afterwards.
